data.long_meaning: The name Chiranjeev is derived from Sanskrit and is a combination of two words: 'Chira' meaning 'eternal' and 'Anjeev' meaning 'living'. It is the name of a character in Hindu mythology, believed to be an immortal being or a god. The name Chiranjeev carries the meaning “Eternal, Immortal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chiranjeev usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, immortal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
